description: The chart illustrates GLUE performance for several parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, shown separately for two RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis contains the categorical fine-tuning methods labeled (from left to right) “Prefix,” “Adaptor,” “LoRA,” “BitFit,” “S₁-model,” “S₄-model,” and “S₅-model,” under the axis label “Fine-tuning Method,” and the categories appear in this fixed listed order (not visibly sorted by value). The vertical axis is labeled “GLUE Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks at 86 and 88 (values extend a bit below 86 and above 88, roughly spanning the mid‑84s to just above 89). Each category has two adjacent bars forming a grouped layout, with color indicating “RoBERTa Size” per the legend: blue for “base” and orange for “large.” Approximate bar heights are: Prefix (base ≈84.6, large ≈85.7), Adaptor (base ≈84.4, large ≈88.1), LoRA (base ≈86.6, large ≈89.0), BitFit (base ≈84.3, large ≈87.7), S₁-model (base ≈85.6, large ≈85.6), S₄-model (base ≈86.2, large ≈87.6), and S₅-model (base ≈87.0, large ≈89.3). The shortest bar appears around BitFit/base (just above 84), and the tallest around S₅-model/large (a little above 89), and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding and legend.
